question: What is the average review score of orders with exactly one item minus that of orders with more than one item?
sql:
WITH order_item_counts AS (
    SELECT
        oi.order_id,
        COUNT(*) AS item_cnt
    FROM order_items oi
    GROUP BY oi.order_id
),
review_scores AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        r.review_score
    FROM orders o
    JOIN reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN order_item_counts c ON c.order_id = o.order_id
)
SELECT
    AVG(CASE WHEN item_cnt = 1 THEN review_score END) -
    AVG(CASE WHEN item_cnt > 1 THEN review_score END) AS avg_score_diff
FROM (
    SELECT
        r.order_id,
        r.review_score,
        c.item_cnt
    FROM review_scores r
    JOIN order_item_counts c ON c.order_id = r.order_id
) t
